title: Human actors
summary: A teammate code invite creates a new human actor and their normal operator org role in the same transaction as a hashed, single-use code. A name never selects an existing actor. Codes expire after 24 hours; expiry or revocation keeps the actor, and reissue gives that actor a replacement code. Redeeming a code registers one machine and its credential atomically. Disabled actors cannot redeem or receive reissued codes.
